requestedLayout.altar: 底部低祭坛、平坦空台面；上部窄弯曲古金石拱。

reviewSummary: 三张独立场景，主题分别为暖红熔金古殿、月下藤叶古林、深蓝霜晶圣殿；统一精细手绘哥特奇幻工艺。
已检查工具输出显示：没有人物、怪物、脸、人物雕像或烘焙文字/按钮/卡槽。中心留空，没有巨大光球或明火遮住未来角色。
中心低对比、边缘细节较多。左右UI范围保留连续环境而不是空白矩形或现代模板。
角色轻微头发/衣摆动画、职业光效、按钮/经济/UI/路由由主Agent单独实现，本交付是静态opaque背景。
limitations: 三图祭坛实际高度略有差异；下面落脚提示为目视估计，主Agent需在独立角色层接入后校准。
原图比例为3:2；16:9 cover会裁掉部分上下装饰，需按最终界面检查background-position和脚点。没有修改原图来适配。
火图右上有小月亮与边缘烛光，森图左上有细小月光点，均在角色主体区外；右侧文字仍建议使用DOM暗底渐变或阴影实测可读性。
风格/美观和轻微动态效果仍待用户主观验收；目视检查原图不代表已完成应用UI验收。

files.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: complete opaque environment background for a dedicated fire-mage hero summoning page in an original Gothic dark-fantasy game.
Primary request: ONE independent 1536 x 1024 landscape PNG, opaque painted scene, NO characters. A magnificent ancient furnace sanctum at midnight, refined hand-painted 2D fantasy game illustration with tactile painted stone, wrought bronze and sculpted antique-gold details. Match the artistry of a richly illustrated moonlit Gothic castle lobby and ornate antique-gold moon-wing UI, while creating an original fire-themed sanctuary. Not photorealistic, not a modern flat template.

Composition is an intentional shared production layout:
- The LEFTMOST 15 percent of the image and RIGHTMOST 30 percent must remain dark, visually calm and low contrast so navigation and readable UI text can be overlaid later. These are still continuous painted environment, not panels or empty rectangles. Put most intricate edge ornament in the far corners and along the very top edge.
- A separate transparent full-body heroine layer will later stand around x38 to55 percent, from y15 to92 percent. Keep this entire tall area clear of prominent structures, bright sources, foreground objects and detailed patterns. Behind this character zone use a quiet, softly shaded charcoal and muted blue stone recess with gentle haze. DO NOT paint a heroine, humanoid silhouette or placeholder.
- At bottom, centered around x46 percent, provide one low broad ancient ritual altar/plinth with a flat top near y90 to92 percent, dark stone with delicate dim molten-gold inlays. Its thin raised front is low enough that a future character will be the focus. No huge glowing summoning circle, no upright portal or luminous sphere.
- A graceful curved dark stone arch with aged gold vine-scroll relief can frame the top edge. Its border is narrow and sculptural, not a thick UI frame. Side arches recede into deep space; realistic layered Gothic masonry, iron candle brackets and subtle carved decoration along edges.

Fire-theme environment: a ruined furnace chapel with dark basalt floors and vaulted arch fragments, a few warm red-amber candles and restrained ember-gold inlaid sigils integrated in stone, antique brass details catching low warm light. Through the distant broken arches at the middle-right background, a glimpse of cold dark-blue moonlit castle ruins and midnight sky provides depth. No large furnace flame, no eruption, no flowing foreground lava. Sparse tiny embers near the edges only, not across the future heroine's face. Leave subtle future animation possibilities in a few distant candleflames and ember flecks.

Lighting/color: midnight charcoal and dark desaturated indigo, small warm garnet/amber accents, aged gold, soft painterly atmospheric depth. The center character background has low contrast, no glaring hotspot; far background is subdued and a little softer than edge masonry. Highest detail and contrast belong to peripheral carved elements, still tastefully restrained. Beautiful premium game artwork, composed for a heroine to be layered later.

Absolute constraints: no people, no hero, no creature, no face, no skull, no figurative statue, no humanoid shadow, no hands, no portraits, no weapons standing like a person. No text, letters, digits, readable writing, labels, buttons, UI boxes, grids, card slots, logos, watermarks, checkerboard or transparency. No central giant lightball, no blinding white glow, no full-screen fire, no overexposure. This is only the opaque environment background.
files.visualReview: 中央沉静暗殿，远右暗蓝月夜，暖烛与熔金雕纹主要在边缘。低台面完整，无中心火球或人物。

altarFootHintNormalized.basis: 目视估计；平顶区域约y875～900px，接入后校准角色脚点。

futureAmbientHints: 少量边缘暖色余烬；不覆盖角色脸和右侧文字
